images.screen: A · 조합 — '강'에 새 정의를 조립하는 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of a bright commercial word-puzzle game in the spirit of Baba Is You. Clean flat vector art with thick black outlines and hard offset drop shadows, sticker-book look on cream dotted paper. Left: a top-down tile board framed in chunky cobalt-blue wall blocks, a vertical blue river with wavy lines splits the room, a round white hero with a red cap on the left bank, a gold key and a wooden arched door on the right bank, two mint trees; each object carries a small white word tag. Dashed white outlines on the river preview the change. Right: a definition workbench card showing a big blue word tile, its old meaning struck through in red, and an equation row of colored word-fragment chips with one blinking empty slot, plus arrow chains of inferred properties. Bottom: a cobalt tray of chunky colored fragment chips (mint, mustard, periwinkle, coral), one lifted. Korean UI: "단어 연금술", "정의 조합대", "정의를 새긴다". Palette cobalt, vermilion, mustard, mint on cream. Text constraints: the big blue word tile on the workbench and the river's word tag both read "강"; the old meaning struck through is "흐르는 물"; the equation row reads "얼음" + "길" + one blinking empty slot, and the dashed preview on the river reads "강 → 얼음길". Spelling constraint: the red workbench heading is exactly "정의 조합대" (정의 = definition, with 의), never "정어 조합대" or any other variant; render every Korean label with correct spelling.

images.screen: B · 성립 — 강이 얼음길이 되고 정의가 통한 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of the success moment in a bright commercial word-puzzle game. Same flat vector sticker style with thick black outlines. On the left tile board the river has turned into pale cracked ice with white glints; the round red-capped hero stands smiling on the ice with a trail of footprints behind, the gold key flies up with a small burst and a red floating label. A big vermilion rubber stamp, slightly rotated with ink texture, is slammed onto the board. Right: a lined notebook dictionary page with a red margin shows a newly coined word in large bold type with a blue handwritten-style definition, three stat tiles and two of three gold stars. Bottom: a mint banner announcing a new object added to the collection with a big 17 of 200 counter and a cobalt next-room button. Colorful Hangul letter confetti falls across the screen. Korean UI: "정의 성립!", "얼음길", "다음 방". Joyful, punchy, cobalt, vermilion, mustard and mint on cream. Consistency: it is the same room as before — cream dotted floor framed by chunky cobalt-blue wall blocks, two mint trees, the wooden arched door on the right — and the vertical strip where the river was is now pale cracked ice; the hero is the same round white character with a small red cap (no backpack or scarf). The dictionary definition reads exactly "얼음길 [명사] 강이 얼어 걸을 수 있게 된 길."
